name: Suncoast Youth Conservation Center Teen Day Camps
org: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC), Suncoast Youth Conservation Center
what_you_do: Join a week-long day camp for ages 14 to 17. The Hooked on Conservation Camp and the Paddle Adventure Camp are the two teen camps on the schedule. Drop off in the morning and go home in the afternoon.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17 for the Hooked on Conservation and Paddle Adventure weeks. Age is counted on the first day of the camp week.
pay_detail: Camp price is not stated on the program page. Limited scholarships: email Suncoast@MyFWC.com. A $25 non-refundable deposit applies.
deadline_text: Applications open 8:00 a.m. Eastern on Feb 1, 2027. First come, first served with a waitlist. The page lists camp weeks from June 1 to July 31.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Camp Registration Portal. No payment is due until you get a spot. Payment is due 14 days after you are told you have a spot.
notes: Capacity is 20 per teen week, so spots go fast. Address: 6650 Dickman Rd, Apollo Beach, FL. Phone 813-922-7961.
